name: Ttdinject.exe
description: Used by Windows 1809 and newer to Debug Time Travel (Underlying call of tttracer.exe)
author: Maxime Nadeau

commands.description: Execute a program using ttdinject.exe. Requires administrator privileges. A log file will be created in tmp.run. The log file can be changed, but the length (7) has to be updated.

detection: Parent child relationship. Ttdinject.exe parent for executed command
